data.one_liner: A Flutter package for using the UIcons Icon Pack as IconData.
data.what_it_does: Provides an IconPack of UIcons by RedLeaf Softs as IconData for Flutter applications. It aggregates multiple icon style sub-packages like regular straight, regular rounded, bold straight, and brands into a single convenient interface.
use_when: You want to use UIcons from Flaticon within your Flutter application.
You need various styles of icons such as rounded, straight, bold, solid, and brands.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material or Cupertino icons.
You require custom SVG icons that are not part of the UIcons icon pack.
strengths: Easy integration with standard Flutter Icon widgets.
Supports multiple icon styles (regular, bold, solid, brands, etc.).
weaknesses: Relies on multiple sub-dependencies for different icon packs.
Not documented with explicit usage guidelines beyond basic examples.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package to use the icons.
